$comment: The strategy document asks for verification state to be tracked in a
`_meta.verified` array per file. It cannot live inside the namespace files
value in a scanned namespace is a non-empty string, and a `_meta` object
would fail that. So the ledger sits beside them, and check-i18n.mjs reads
`verifiedBy` records WHO signed a namespace off, because that is the fact
the ADR-021 ship gate actually turns on. Two values are used:
owner   — the project owner reviewed and accepted these strings.
claude  — machine-translated from the sourced English, NOT yet read by
a Hindi-literate reviewer. Present and parity-complete, but

The blanket "*" was replaced with the explicit key list on 2026-08-13, when the productization pass added new keys: those additions are machine-translated and are NOT covered by this sign-off.
